Logic gates turn binary inputs into a binary output. Explore all five gates; the highlighted truth-table row follows your switches.
A bit is either 0 or 1. Here, 0 means OFF and 1 means ON. Real circuits represent bits using ranges of electrical voltage, not a single universal voltage.
Before toggling a switch, predict whether the output will change. Then check the table.

Transistors act as tiny switches. Connected gates form circuits that add numbers, compare values, and control data. Registers store bits, and a CPU follows instructions. A gate is one building block, not an entire computer.

Khmer One is a centralized, offline-ready educational portal delivering bilingual tools in STEM, health, computer engineering, financial literacy, and women's enterprise. Designed specifically for Cambodian teenagers, students, and educators to learn, build, and thrive.

Our mission is to make practical education easier to access across Cambodia. Khmer One brings specialized learning apps together in one place, so students and educators can discover a subject, practice a skill, and build something useful for their community.

The camshaft times the valves. Its lobes push the valves open, and springs return them to the closed position.
អ័ក្សកាមបង្វិល ១ ជុំ ខណៈអ័ក្សក្រឡឹងបង្វិល ២ ជុំ។
The camshaft makes one turn for every two crankshaft turns.
The piston moves down. The intake valve opens and the air–fuel mixture enters the cylinder; the exhaust valve stays closed.
ពិស្តុងចុះក្រោម។ វ៉ាល់ស្រូបបើក ដើម្បីឱ្យល្បាយខ្យល់ និងឥន្ធនៈចូលស៊ីឡាំង ខណៈវ៉ាល់បញ្ចេញបិទ។
វគ្គបង្ហាប់
The piston rises with both valves closed, compressing the mixture. At the end of this stroke, the spark plug ignites it.
ពិស្តុងឡើងលើ ហើយវ៉ាល់ទាំងពីរបិទ ដើម្បីបង្ហាប់ល្បាយ។ នៅចុងវគ្គនេះ ប៊ូស៊ីបញ្ឆេះល្បាយ។
វគ្គបង្កើតកម្លាំង
Both valves stay closed. Combustion produces hot expanding gas that pushes the piston down and turns the crankshaft.
វ៉ាល់ទាំងពីរបិទ។ ការឆេះបង្កើតឧស្ម័នក្តៅដែលរីកមាឌ រុញពិស្តុងចុះ និងធ្វើឱ្យអ័ក្សក្រឡឹងបង្វិល។
វគ្គបញ្ចេញ
The exhaust valve opens and the piston rises, pushing burned gases out. The intake valve stays closed. The cycle then repeats.
វ៉ាល់បញ្ចេញបើក ហើយពិស្តុងឡើងលើ ដើម្បីរុញឧស្ម័នដែលបានឆេះចេញ។ វ៉ាល់ស្រូបបិទ។ បន្ទាប់មក វដ្តចាប់ផ្ដើមឡើងវិញ។
